description: This file defines the LeavePeriodModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits related to model serialization. The class serves as a model wrapper for LeavePeriod data transfer objects (DTOs), providing filtering and attribute mapping functionalities.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps the LeavePeriod DTO, enabling serialization and filtering capabilities for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a LeavePeriod DTO, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
